sentence: Builds algorithms that automatically generate labeled training data so machine learning models can be trained accurately when human-labeled data is hard to get.
Studies the theory of quantum pseudorandomness, information that appears more random than it actually is, and explores its uses in cryptography.
Builds an open-source simulation platform where researchers can test AI methods for autonomous driving.
Studies which genes and traits helped populations of the common monkeyflower adapt to severe drought, and tests how they may cope with climate change.
Builds a tool that shines extreme ultraviolet light on resist materials to watch the chemical changes used in making computer chips.
Uses machine learning on health records to find patients likely to develop chronic conditions early, while keeping patient privacy protected.
Studies how carriers called invertible micellar assemblies interact with the biopolymer cargos they hold when the environment changes.
Develops algorithms for quantum computers to understand the mechanics of strongly correlated materials.
Develops ways for robots to navigate public walkways safely and communicate with people, using feedback from community members to train them.
Studies how plasma forms and how electrons collide in it when high-power lasers hit solid materials, at different laser wavelengths.
Develops phosphoserine lipids for lipid nanoparticles that deliver mRNA to target organs and cells and reduce the immune response.
Searches for extremely low mass satellite galaxies around dwarf galaxies and measures their distances, numbers and sizes to test cold dark matter models.
Develops theory to understand how quarks and gluons inside protons and neutrons give nucleons properties such as spin.
Supports a workshop about designing effective interactions with robots, drawing on robotics, human factors and behavioral sciences.
Uses multiscale simulations to design and make metal-insulator-metal nanoprobes that detect molecules in liquids with surface-enhanced Raman spectroscopy.
Builds a way to turn sensor data from images, laser scanning and accelerometers into models that show how real structures behave.
Studies how well deep neural networks that preserve symmetry keep working when the symmetry is contaminated by signal deformation.
